random_definition: Uniform permutation of the fixed observed candidate labels, equivalent to iid continuous random scores independent of labels.
random_AP_formula: For N>1 and M>0: M/N + (1-M/N)*(H_N-1)/(N-1); H_N=sum(1/k,k=1..N). For N=M=1: 1. No positive class: AP not reported.
random_P_at_K_formula: M/N for each query with N>=K; macro baseline averages this over eligible queries.
all_tied_AP: A constant-score classifier has AP=M/N, which differs from finite random-permutation expected AP.
outside_union_note: Single-endpoint panels and the pooled-label panel apply different aggregation eligibility; these 319 pairs are not additional rows of the pooled binary panel.
limitations: Random baselines are conditioned on this observed test pool, not the unmeasured project matrix.
AP is not classification accuracy or expected SPR hit rate.
Single-class inactivity panel has no discriminative AUROC/AP.
Panel rows and directional query populations overlap and must not be summed as independent pairs.
